enabled.description: All calls will be sent to voicemail.

sendAllCalls.description: Settings for sending all calls to voicemail.

enabled.description: Calls will be sent to voicemail when busy.

greeting.description:
`DEFAULT` indicates the default greeting will be played. `CUSTOM` indicates a custom `.wav` file will be played.
 * `DEFAULT` - The default greeting will be played.
 * `CUSTOM` - Designates that a custom `.wav` file will be played.

sendBusyCalls.description: Settings for sending calls to voicemail when the line is busy.

enabled.description: Unanswered call sending to voicemail is enabled or disabled.

greeting.description:
`DEFAULT` indicates the default greeting will be played. `CUSTOM` indicates a custom `.wav` file will be played.
 * `DEFAULT` - The default greeting will be played.
 * `CUSTOM` - Designates that a custom `.wav` file will be played.

numberOfRings.description: Number of rings before an unanswered call will be sent to voicemail. `numberOfRings` must be between 2 and 20, inclusive.

enabled.description: Notifications for voicemails will be sent.

destination.description: Email address to which the notification will be sent. For text messages, use an email to text message gateway like `2025551212@txt.att.net`.

notifications.description: Settings for notifications when there are any new voicemails.

enabled.description: Enable or disable  voicemail caller transfer to a destination by pressing zero (0).

destination.description: Number voicemail caller will be transferred to when they press zero (0).

transferToNumber.description: Settings for voicemail caller to transfer to a different number by pressing zero (0).

enabled.description: When `true` copy of new voicemail message audio will be sent to the designated email.

emailId.description: Email address to which the new voicemail audio will be sent.

emailCopyOfMessage.description: Settings for sending a copy of new voicemail message audio via email.

mwiEnabled.description: When `true` desktop phone will indicate there are new voicemails.

storageType.description:
Designates which type of voicemail message storage is used.
 * `INTERNAL` - Internal mailbox storage has the following limitations: Single message limit of 10 minutes and total mailbox limit of 100 minutes.
 * `EXTERNAL` - If `EXTERNAL` is selected, all messages will be sent to the email address entered. Messages will not be accessible via phone, clients, or the end user's calling portal.

externalEmail.description: External email address to which the new voicemail audio will be sent.

enabled.description: When `true` FAX messages for new voicemails are sent to the designated number.
